summary.text: Joe Funkhouser is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates, representing District 98 in Jefferson County, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, he was appointed to the seat by Governor Jim Justice in October 2024.

paragraphs.text: Joe Funkhouser graduated from Jefferson High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Shepherd University in 2006, and received a law degree from the West Virginia University College of Law in 2010.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up on a farm, has professional experience as a civil litigation and business attorney and as an assistant prosecuting attorney, and served eight years on the Jefferson County Farmland Protection Board.

He has also served on the board of the Charles Town Horsemen's Benevolent and Protective Association and the Charles Town Racetrack Chaplaincy Board, and has been affiliated with the Jefferson County Farm Bureau and the Bridge Community Church.
Governor Jim Justice appointed Funkhouser to District 98 on October 16, 2024, to replace Paul Espinosa, and he assumed office on October 21, 2024.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
In the 2026 survey, he said he introduced bills in his first term on lowering taxes, increasing the homestead exemption, locality pay, water protection, school safety and public safety.
